Through the glass, he saw a green coat, dripping seawater, and a hand raised in a gesture he remembered well.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把空荡的街道照得微黄，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下潮湿的水痕。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽从锅盖边缘溢出。远处，一辆夜班公交停在站台，只有司机和两个疲倦的乘客。风吹动便利店门口的塑料帘，天边还没有亮，生活却已悄悄醒来。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no box inside."}
